question_text: Make five sentences using the parts of sentences from each column of the table below:
stimulus: Newspaper wants curious by nature. It has to know various things of the world. Man is a great educative value. He shows one of the best media to satisfy his curiosity. us the outside world like a mirror.
guide_solution: (a) Man is curious by nature. (b) He wants to know various things of the world. (c) Newspapers is one of the best media to satisfy his curiosity. (d) It has a great educative value. (e) It shows us the outside world like a mirror.
